profile.headline: Software Developer at Applicaster
profile.summary:
Technically savvy individual with experience in all types of industries. 

Somebody who, always is going to continue developing and refining his skills, and has a good understanding of some of the most popularly used web technologies.

Feel free to ask me about those technologies and my comfort with them. 
Programming as much as I can, at work and in my free time so that I can keep working in STEM related industries. Currently learning about progressive web applications, mobile web development, and ARIA / accessibility in web development.

With Ironhack I learned to work with several technologies including; JavaScript, TypeScript, SASS, Angular, MongoDB, Express, jQuery, Bootstrap  and others.

Learned React, Ruby, Rails, MySQL, Redux, Firebase Realtime DB, Service Workers, Flexbox, CSS Grid, Handlebars, Wordpress, HTML, CSS, Deploying to Digital Ocean, AWS S3, AWS Lamda, Docker, OVH VPS, Virtual Box, and much more on my own.

Working with Flexshopper helped me get more comfortable with React, Redux, MySQL, Jest, Pact, Mocha, Chai, Joi, Hapi, Sequelize, RabbitMQ, Domain Driven Design, Event Driven Architecture, Test Driven Design, Continuous Integration, Kubernetes, Microservice Architecture, and NewRelic APM, SessionCam to mention a few.  

Before that used to work as a Teacher Assistant at the University of Miami, alongside the professor we taught students the MERN stack along with some computer science fundamentals, and simultaneously worked at a mechanical consulting/engineering firm in South Florida, together we were heavily involved with the growth and development of our community.

Every job I have ever had has taught me so much, and I am grateful for the opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Learned so much with this company, worked with a Kubernetes microservice architecture that allowed us to have a continuous integration of all of the services used to operate the site. Primarily worked with several back-end APIs that fed the site. The bulk of the time was spent on the customer management RESTful API, an event driven API that synchronized changes between services, and a React Redux intranet site to handle administrative tasks for customers. Each API had a different philosophy so worked with Event Driven Architecture, Test Driven Design, and Domain Driven Design. This allowed me to use tools such as RabbitMQ, Jest, Enzyme, Pact, Docker, Mocha, Chai, Ramda, and more.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Working with Trilogy Education as Teacher Assistant for the program's Web Development Bootcamp at the University of Miami. As a TA I work closely with the instructor, staff, and students. Solving problems with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, MySQL, React, Handlebars, GitHub, Heroku, Node, MongoDB, and much more. It is a learning experience for both I and the students who we carefully guide along the path to become a Web Developers. Daily activities include troubleshooting and debugging students code, grading homework, assisting in lectures, and providing constant support and reinforcement in person and through slack.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
GM Consulting Engineers is a Mechanical Consulting/Engineering firm that specializes in Architectural Engineering and design, such as Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection.

Our clients needed designers so we decided to go into another venture aligned with the teams technical background in mechanical engineering. Along with the principal engineer I helped draft the articles of incorporation, and registered/incorporated the new business with the State of Florida. Later registered the business with Florida Department of Professional Regulation, and got the company insured. Our team now has designed hundreds of properties worth millions of dollars all around Florida, and Latin America. Some clients include The Smithsonian, 3M, & Grainger.

-Primary roles: Office manager/Administrative manager, as the office manager of the company I'm in charge of all the business activities. Everything required to keep the business in operation including managing the Utilities, Payroll, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, Proposals, Contract Documents, Financial Reports and Forecasting, and maintaining our registrations with local and state governments. Also work with local authorities having jurisdiction over our projects, to review  plans and ensure that they comply with any local ordinances. At the company I also deployed a new server, and network where I manage the domain, DNS, DHCP, and the Active Directory on a Window Server. When managing this network I also maintain and repair all of the workstations, DSX phones,  software, email, and backups.  Work alongside engineers to produce specifications documents, and proof drawings.

- Other roles include: Business development, I worke alongside the principals to further develop the company. The company is now a registered Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and is on track to become registered in the state as a DBE, and registered with the NCEES so that we can register our firm all across the nation, starting with Virginia.

positions.title: Administrative Manager
positions.description:
MC&C Services is a Plumbing and Mechanical Contracting company in South Florida that primarily works in Commercial and Government renovation type projects. For over 10 years the company has worked alongside other contractors to do millions of dollars of renovations for the United States Post Offices and the Miami-Dade School Board.  I was originally brought into this company a few days after I had left my previous employer and was originally brought in as a office manager.  As the company's needs changed so have my roles. 

- Primary roles : Administrative manager, as an administrative manager I would take care of almost every aspect of the business to ensure that our technicians can work without any issues. That involves all of the business activities such as Payroll, Human Resources, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, Estimating, and much more. I would make sure our licenses were properly registered with the state and local authorities, pay for local business taxes, file annual reports. Also would work as a project manager to keep schedules, create gantt charts for projects, draft proposals, send purchase orders, keep track of project cost, and perform profit and loss reports. Along with that I would assist our controller reconciling accounts, create sales tax reports record deposits, and address several accounting issues that may arise. I worked with manufacturers, engineering representatives, and local distributors to gather all of the information needed to install equipment on the field. I also submitted documents to engineers on record such as spec sheets, RFIs,  submittals, and as-builts. Created the company's website, and maintained it's online presence. 

- Other roles included: Procurement and exporting of mechanical equipment and other goods. Before Pacific Hardware I would procure and export all sorts of equipment to Panama for several projects throughout the country. Some of the most notable procurement projects include the remodeling of the Marriott.

positions.title: Purchasing Manager
positions.description:
Pacific Hardware was a hardware store in a special government district in Panama that was quickly developing into one of the fastest growing commercial and industrial regions in the country. As we were involved with lots of this growth with our engineering firm. The owners of the hardware store reached out to me to source lots of specialized equipment that was not available in Panama.

- Primary roles included: Purchasing specialized equipment not available in the region in United States for export to Panama. Worked with engineering representatives, distributors, freight forwarders and equipment manufacturers to get the products manufactured to their needs. Together we supplied equipment of all types, included raised flooring, LED lighting, duplex pump systems, acoustic ceiling panels, and mechanical equipment.

positions.title: Server
positions.locationName: 2167 South Bayshore Drive Cononut Grove, FL 33133
positions.description:
Bill Hansen Catering is one of the most well known catering companies in South Florida. They are a luxury and special event production company that has been serving some of the most important and influential people in the world including our former presidents, musicians, entrepreneurs, religious figures, and more. While working with Bill Hansen was not  a career directly involved with my industry it was an adventure. I worked with the catering team as a part time server/event setup specialist for over 2 years. In that time we served, non-profit organizations, weddings, presidential advisors, CFOs of large banks, and various international corporations. It was incredible working with teams of almost a hundred people to help create these special events.

- Primary roles included: Setup of special events, unloading and placement of food and,  kitchen equipment. Helped bartenders get all of the necessary tools and spirits. Serving and greeting guest.

positions.title: Sales Consultant / Business Development
positions.description:
Active Autowerke is a small local business that is well known by BMW owners all over the country as one of the best tuners BMW tuners that have ever existed. Active Autowerke specializes in forced induction for cars that were well known for being Naturally Aspirated.  Days after leaving Dell I was messaged  by the manager over at Active Autowerke, who I have done a bit of business with in the past. He asked what I was up to, and as somebody who was recently laid off by a company I was not doing anything. I was immediately offered a job as a Sales Consultant.

- Primary roles included: Sales or Post Sales Consulting, due to the nature of the business most of the sales leads were not local. Communicated with customers via social media, forums, and generated interest for products by creating sales. Created business relationships all around the world, negotiated with clients in Bolivia, Canada, Panama, Haiti, Dominican Republic, Syria, and more. Helped develop business to business software program. Educated customers about the products, the automobile modifications we offered were not only a big investment but it required a lot of coordination.  

- Other roles included: Service Advisor, local clients would come in to the shop to service, repair, tune, and modify their vehicles at our shop, and I would advise clients and relay to the best of our ability the information gathered by the technicians. Would help customers seek alternate transportation, and on occasion would pick up or drive clients to their end destination. Traveled to trade shows with the company for large BMW events in Orlando. Worked alongside technicians and lead Mechanical Engineer in the development of new supercharger systems using tools such as SolidWorks. Also helped provide content, and edit images for newly updated website.

positions.title: Computer Technician / Shipping & Receiving Sr. Associate
positions.description:
Although the experience was short lived working with Alienware, who later was bought out by Dell, was one of the most memorable experiences of my career.
 
- Primary roles included: Working alongside technicians who repaired desktop and laptop computers that have been sent in for repair. Shipping and receiving computers/ logging relevant information using Microsoft Enterprise Navision software. RMA process also had me coordinating with all of the other departments within the company such as Manufacturing, Inventory, Management, Marketing, Customer Service, Shipping and QA Departments. 

- Other roles: Due to the inter-department communication I had I would constantly work with other departments, was a licensed forklift operator that worked with inventory team. Repaired and diagnosed computers with the warranty team. Flashed hardware components with latest firmware using test bed setups. Worked with QA team deploying software and stress testing computers before reaching end user. Worked with department that received promotional and marketing equipment from tradeshows, using Microsoft Sharepoint logged and retrieved the assets to re-integrate with inventory.

honors.title: Grow with Google Challenge Scholarship
honors.description: I was recently awarded a Grow with Google Challenge Scholarship for the Mobile Web Specialist course at Udacity. The Mobile Web Specialist track leads me into the 6 month Nano-Degree.

honors.title: Uber Scholarship
honors.description: Uber Scholarship / Grant to stimulate the tech industry in South Florida. Together with Ironhack they allocated thousands of dollars for students of all backgrounds to attend their Web Development course, and I was  one of the few applicants to be awarded. it was a great honor and it jump-started my career and web development.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer at the Humane Society of Greater Miami, for special fundraising events such as Bark at the Park, Clear the Shelters, and Mega Adoptathon. Also occasionally foster baby kittens in need of a place to stay for a few nights.
Fostered a few pets in need of a temporary home for Miami-Dade County Animal Services. So far we have fostered two doggos.
